messages.english: Length unit
messages.translation: Yuniti ea bolelele

messages.english: Metres (m)
messages.translation: Limithara (m)

messages.english: Feet (ft)
messages.translation: Maoto (ft)

messages.english: Use decimal numbers with a dot or comma; either is a decimal separator. No digit grouping, fractions or unit suffixes. Direction stays in degrees. Switching units changes entry and display only; saved dimensions remain in metres.
messages.translation: Sebelisa linomoro tsa desimale tse nang le khutlo kapa feelwane; e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ke karohanyo ea desimale (decimal separator). Ha ho na ho kopanngoa ha linomoro (digit grouping), likaroloana (fractions) kapa mehatlana ea liyuniti. Tataiso (direction) e lula e le ka li-degrees. Ho fetola liyuniti ho fetola ho kenya le pontšo feela; litekanyo tse bolokiloeng li lula li le ka limithara.

messages.english: Your current entries keep their original unit. Choose a unit explicitly to change it.
messages.translation: Tseo u li kentseng hona joale li boloka yuniti ea tsona ea pele. Khetha yuniti ka ho hlaka ho e fetola.

messages.english: Unit choice remembered on this device.
messages.translation: Khetho ea yuniti e hopotsoe sesebelisoa sena.

messages.english: Unit choice applies only to this sample session.
messages.translation: Khetho ea yuniti e sebetsa feela nakong ena ea mohlala (sample session).

messages.english: Unit choice works here, but could not be remembered on this device.
messages.translation: Khetho ea yuniti ea sebetsa mona, empa ha ea ka ea hopoloa sesebelisoa sena.

messages.english: Complete valid decimal dimensions before changing units. Your entries and their current unit have been kept.
messages.translation: Tlatsa litekanyo tse nepahetseng tsa desimale pele u fetola liyuniti. Tseo u li kentseng le yuniti ea tsona ea hona joale li ntse li tlohetsoe foromong.

messages.english: The account or sample context changed. Reopen the design to load its field settings.
messages.translation: Boemo ba ak'haonte kapa ba mohlala bo fetohile. Bula moralonyana hape ho jarisa litlhophiso tsa tšimo ea oona.

messages.english: Checking the account or sample context before showing field settings.
messages.translation: Ho hlahlobjoa boemo ba ak'haonte kapa ba mohlala pele ho bontšoa litlhophiso tsa tšimo.

messages.english: The saved field, map scale or account context changed. Your draft has been kept. Reload the field settings before applying.
messages.translation: Tšimo e bolokiloeng, sekala sa 'mapa (map scale) kapa boemo ba ak'haonte bo fetohile. Moralo oa hau o sa qetoang (draft) o ntse o tlohetsoe foromong. Jarisa litlhophiso tsa tšimo bocha pele u li sebelisa.

messages.english: Complete valid decimal bed and path dimensions before applying.
messages.translation: Tlatsa litekanyo tse nepahetseng tsa desimale tsa libethe tsa temo (beds) le litselana pele u li sebelisa.

messages.english: Reload field settings
messages.translation: Jarisa litlhophiso tsa tšimo bocha

messages.english: The field or account context changed. Reload the field settings before applying.
messages.translation: Boemo ba tšimo kapa ba ak'haonte bo fetohile. Jarisa litlhophiso tsa tšimo bocha pele u li sebelisa.

messages.english: Enter field-block bed and path dimensions in metres or feet.
messages.translation: Kenya litekanyo tsa libethe tsa temo (beds) le litselana tsa boloko ea tšimo ka limithara kapa maoto.

messages.english: Keep saved measurements unchanged when switching the displayed unit.
messages.translation: Boloka litekanyo tse bolokiloeng li sa fetohe ha u fetola yuniti e bontšitsoeng.

messages.english: Choose field-block units
messages.translation: Khetha liyuniti tsa boloko ea tšimo

messages.english: Site design → Planting → Field blocks
messages.translation: Moralo oa sebaka → Ho jala → Liboloko tsa masimo

messages.english: Select a field, choose metres or feet, enter your dimensions and review the beds before saving. Open fields keep their polygon area without generating beds.
messages.translation: Khetha tšimo, khetha limithara kapa maoto, kenya litekanyo tsa hau 'me u hlahlobe libethe tsa temo (beds) pele u boloka. Masimo a bulehileng a boloka sebaka sa 'ona sa polygon ntle le ho etsa libethe tsa temo (beds).
